action_visual: Chen Rui arrives in a polo shirt, an even more expensive watch than Gu Shen's on his wrist, and pushes a contract onto the counter
source_text: 陈锐来的时候穿了polo衫。看看条件

action_visual: Su Nian opens the contract, the figure large enough to buy an apartment, and refuses flatly
Chen Rui laughs, deep crow's feet at his eyes, arguing her shop cannot compete with the office building's coffee machine
spoken_dialogue: 你这家店月流水不到两万。你拼不过的。你喝什么？
source_text: 你拼不过的。你喝什么。意式浓缩

action_visual: Su Nian makes an espresso and serves it; Chen Rui takes a sip and raises an eyebrow, the cup still warm with a single mouthful left
focus_object: espresso cup with one mouthful left
source_text: 苏念做好端上去。豆子不错。只有一小口，但足够了

action_visual: Su Nian picks up the cup and closes her eyes

the world falls silent; Chen Rui's inner voice surfaces, then an image flickers — a younger Chen Rui standing before a smaller shop with a 'Rui Coffee' sign, smiling, holding a latte with a crooked heart in the foam
inner_voice: ……条件开得够高了。她不识货。但老陈说得对，这条街要改造，她的店迟早要拆。不过……这咖啡确实好喝。比我十年前自己开的那家强……
focus_object: crooked heart latte art in the vision
source_text: 她的店迟早要拆。比我十年前自己开的那家强。画面：更年轻的陈锐，锐咖啡，拉花是爱心

action_visual: Su Nian sets the cup down and cuts through his sales pitch, revealing she knows about his old shop 'Rui Coffee' and his heart latte art
spoken_dialogue: 你也开过咖啡店。锐咖啡。你自己冲的拿铁，拉花是爱心。
source_text: 你也开过咖啡店。锐咖啡。你自己冲的拿铁，拉花是爱心

action_visual: Chen Rui's smile freezes and his face goes pale as he demands to know how she knows
source_text: 陈锐的脸白了。你怎么知道的

action_visual: Su Nian washes the cup under hot water and looks at her right inner wrist — the steam-wand burn scar from learning latte art is gone, the skin smooth as if never scalded
focus_object: smooth wrist where the burn scar vanished
source_text: 右手手腕内侧那道拉花烫伤消失了。皮肤光滑得像从未被烫过

action_visual: hot water splashes her wrist, the sting makes her jerk back, the cup slips from her hand and smashes into the sink, shards flying, water splashing her apron
source_text: 杯子从手里滑落，砸在水池底部。碎片飞溅

action_visual: Su Nian stares at the cup broken into three pieces, her fingers trembling, realizing she once knew how to make latte art but no longer remembers learning it
source_text: 她曾经会拉花。现在她不记得自己学过了
